## The interest base {#fm3-current-balance .fm-slide }

::: {.split}
::: {.column-block}
<h3>Simple interest</h3>

Calculate each period's interest on the **original principal**.

$$\text{Interest}=P\times R$$
:::
::: {.column-block}
<h3>Compound interest</h3>

Calculate each period's interest on the **current balance**.

$$\text{Interest}=\text{current balance}\times R$$
:::
:::

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 7 · One period at a time</p>

::: notes
Booklet §3.1. Reuse the simple-interest calculation with N=1 in each period, but update the base for compound interest. Use the next example for the same numbers as the booklet's worked comparison.
:::
